actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE NEW full-body movement sprite, square native at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA, no sprite sheet.
Reference 1 is the exact identity, reference 2 the approved bright clean rounded hand-painted rendering style only. Preserve the same youthful green-eyed bamboo archer girl, brown high ponytail with jade bamboo leaves and gold hair ornament, ivory and jade-green short robe with delicate warm gold leaf embroidery, ivory shorts, green white gold boots, jade earrings and ribbons. 2.4 heads tall. SAME face, costume, short limbs and proportions; no redesign. Quiver permanently on her anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Original full-length segmented bamboo longbow, around 80% of full character height, carried upright in her anatomical LEFT hand at middle grip near lower chest; relaxed unpulled string, NO arrow in hand or on string. Right hand is free. Full bow including both gold ends visible and held off floor. Front yin-yang buckle exists ONLY on front waist, no yin-yang buckle on the back.
Fixed 10-degree slightly elevated orthographic camera. Full figure and complete equipment inside generous margins, character height 84% of canvas, ground root horizontal center at 92% canvas height. Stable size and camera. One foot always supports ground, gentle normal walking, not running or jumping. Mild opposing right-arm swing; small natural hair and hem follow-through. No shadow, ground, colored background, writing, watermark, panel or multiple poses. Clean antialiased edges with actual alpha transparency. Ignore inherited stray magenta pixels on reference silhouette. Highest host-managed painting quality.
Reference3 is the same character's approved E contact pose, use it to lock details and equipment. Newly draw the requested different pose, do not duplicate.
DIRECTION: EXACT EAST right-facing side profile. Match reference3 camera, face expression, body proportions, clothing, equipment and size. Face and chest point screen RIGHT, only one green eye visible. Anatomical RIGHT leg and free RIGHT arm are nearest camera. Bow is carried by the far-side LEFT hand. No yaw change.
POSE: Frame09/16, RIGHT heel contact, the opposite step to reference3. NEAR right leg reaches forward screen RIGHT with heel on ground; FAR left leg trails behind screen LEFT with heel up and toe contact. Clearly swap which leg is in front compared to reference3. Right free arm swings backward naturally. Bow remains in far left hand, same height and angle as reference3.
